safe.label: Lying awake picturing her with someone else
safe.note: The stated content: jealousy that arrives at night and will not leave.

safe.label: It started casual so he has no claim to press
safe.note: It started out with a kiss, how did it end up like this. He was never officially anything.

safe.label: Calling himself Mr Brightside to stay the good sport
safe.note: Public posture of cheerfulness laid over private wreckage.

real.label: He never asked what they were so it would not count
real.note: Undefined means she cannot leave him, only stop calling. He would rather be a man who was never serious than a man who was weighed and passed on.

real.label: Brightside is the version his friends are allowed to see
real.note: The cheer is not for her and not for himself. It is so nobody at the party files him under the guy who got dropped.

safe.label: The same scene runs on loop until morning
safe.note: Sleep is gone. The problem is not the woman, it is that the mind will not shut off.

real.label: Nobody told him the details, he is directing them
real.note: The cigarette, the touch of his hand, the taxi, the stomach. That is camera work, not information. He is the one staging it and he keeps going back for another take.

safe.label: Telling himself this is the price of a bigger destiny
safe.note: Destiny is calling me. Reframing being passed over as a toll on the way up.
